item.title: P-8 Poseidon Crews Controlling MQ-4C Triton Drones Becoming A Reality
item.summary: The P-8A and MQ-4Cs were designed to work in concert, but direct in-flight control of Tritons will open new tactical possibilities and greatly extend the Poseidon's reach. The post P-8 Poseidon Crews Controlling MQ-4C Triton Drones Becoming A Reality appeared first on TWZ .
